newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.006PTS TO 103.283.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.006PTS TO 103.283.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.006 points in Friday's trading to 103.283 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.005 points to 2.780 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.012 points to 100.937, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.005 points to 2.321 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 0.693 points to 1,022.780.
